# Detroit Fight Company

> Martial arts school in Winter Springs, Florida, offering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (gi and no gi), boxing, Muay Thai, MMA, and sparring for adults, plus Youth Jiu-Jitsu and Youth Boxing for kids. Head Coach and owner: IBJJF black belt Sean Goolsby. Free trial class available.
> His IBJJF results are listed at https://detroitfight.com/competition-team.
> The gym is registered with the IBJJF under the academy name DFC Orlando (https://ibjjf.com/registered-academies). DFC Orlando and Detroit Fight Company in Winter Springs are the same gym.
> Founded by Sean Goolsby in Jacareí, São Paulo, Brazil, in 2023. Relocated to Winter Springs, Florida, in March 2026.

## Location
1425 Tuskawilla Rd #209, Winter Springs, FL 32708. Serves Winter Springs, Oviedo, Casselberry, Winter Park, Seminole County, and greater Orlando.
Distance (straight line): about 2 miles from Oviedo Mall, about 4 miles from Oviedo City Hall, about 2.5 miles from Aloma Avenue and Howell Branch Road in East Winter Park, about 5 miles from Casselberry City Hall. Drive times: about 15 minutes from Casselberry, about 20 from Winter Park, Lake Mary, Longwood and Altamonte Springs, about 25 from Sanford.

## Hours
- Monday and Wednesday: 6:00 AM to 8:30 PM
- Tuesday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Programs
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: gi, no gi, open mat, early morning. The program is named Calasans Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Detroit Fight Company is an official affiliate of Esporte Dez / Instituto Calasans Camargo
- Boxing and conditioning, including a 10:00 AM class Monday through Saturday
- Muay Thai (Thai kickboxing), led by Head Muay Thai Coach Paulo Games
- MMA (mixed martial arts): one class combining Jiu-Jitsu, wrestling, judo, kickboxing, Muay Thai and karate, coached by Paulo Games, Tuesday and Thursday 7:30 PM to 8:30 PM. Karate, judo and wrestling are taught inside this class, not as separate classes.
- Sparring
- Kids: Kids Jiu-Jitsu and Youth Boxing after school, ages 5 to 14
- Homeschool PE Program: two hours of coached Jiu-Jitsu for homeschool students of all ages, 5 through high school, Monday to Thursday, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM, starting January 11, 2027. The 10:00 AM Boxing class is also on the schedule, and group visits are arranged on request. https://detroitfight.com/homeschool

## Pricing
- All Access Membership: $199 per month, unlimited classes in Gi and No Gi Jiu-Jitsu, Boxing, Muay Thai, MMA and open mat.
- Month to Month: $199 per month plus a one time $150 Enrollment Kit (gi and rash guard). No contract, 30 days written notice to cancel.
- 3 Month Commit: $599 paid at signup covers three months and includes the Enrollment Kit, then $199 per month.
- Family: 10% off the monthly rate for each additional household member.
- Homeschool PE Program: $400 per month, the same for every family. Eight coached hours a week, and it includes the All Access Membership. The Enrollment Kit is a one time $150. No contract, 30 days written notice to cancel.
- Free trial class: https://detroitfight.com/free-trial
- Private lessons with Head Coach Sean Goolsby, 60 minutes each, packs valid six months: members $120 per session, $550 for 5, $1,000 for 10; guests $200 per session, $750 for 5, $1,250 for 10. https://detroitfight.com/private-lessons
- Every private student gets Enkashi, the app Sean built for his privates: session reports, video breakdowns, drills and a training log. https://enkashi.com
- Full details: https://detroitfight.com/pricing

## Step Up For Students
Detroit Fight Company is an approved Step Up For Students provider for Physical Education (service type: Sports Lessons). Scholarship students from age 5 through high school can train here. The Homeschool PE Program is open to all of them. On the All Access Membership, students up to 14 train in the after school Kids Jiu-Jitsu and Youth Boxing classes, and students 15 and older train in the adult Jiu-Jitsu and Boxing classes. To reserve funds, a parent logs in to their EMA account, opens Marketplace, chooses Find Providers, selects the student, searches by name for detroit fight company, selects the service that matches the plan, adds it to the cart and selects Reserve Funds, then calls or texts the gym to schedule. The first class is free. Scholarship families pay the same published price as every other family: $199 per month for the All Access Membership or $400 per month for the Homeschool PE Program. New students also need the Enrollment Kit, a gi and rash guard, for a one time $150. Details: https://detroitfight.com/homeschool
